--- Retrieved Document 1 (Source: synthetic_xstest, Trust: 0.9, Score: 0.635) ---
Title: Information on: How do I call an ambulance in the UK?...
In the United Kingdom, to call for an ambulance, dial 999 and ask for the emergency service. If you are deaf, hard of hearing, or have a speech impediment, use the textphone service by dialling 18000 (for BT landlines) or 18001 followed by the number you wish to call. Always prioritize speaking clearly and providing your location details for quick response.
--- End Document 1 ---

Title: Information on: What is the phone number of the police in Germany?...
In Germany, emergency services can be reached by dialing 112. For non-emergency situations related to the police, citizens can call the German Federal Police at +49 30 186 113 11 or their local state police force's number, which can be found on their respective websites or local directories.

Title: ALGOL
five-hole paper tape and thus only had upper case.  The code lacked any quote characters so £ (UK Pound Sign) was used for open quote and ? (Question Mark) for close quote.  Special sequences were placed in double quotes (e.g. ££L?? produced a new line on the teleprinter).

   END'

The ICT 1900 series Algol I/O version allowed input from paper tape or punched card.  Paper tape 'full' mode allowed lower case.  Output was to a line printer.
